items.title: Inbox: #Magic guard Jalen Suggs will serve as a coach at the inaugural Men’s Basketball Without Borders Next Up camp Aug. 26-29 in Istanbul, Türkiye, the league announced.
items.author: Jason Beede
items.body_excerpt:
Inbox: #Magic guard Jalen Suggs will serve as a coach at the inaugural Men’s Basketball Without Borders Next Up camp Aug. 26-29 in Istanbul, Türkiye, the league announced.

80 of the top male, high-school-age prospects from around the world will participate at the camp.
